Class ManagerCtrl.ColumnCurrencyFormatSetter<RowData,T>

java.lang.Object
com.app.ManagerCtrl.ColumnCurrencyFormatSetter<RowData,T>
Type Parameters:
RowData - The structure representing each row of the Table.
T - The type of data in the column to be formatted as currency.
Enclosing class:
ManagerCtrl
class ManagerCtrl.ColumnCurrencyFormatSetter<RowData,T> extends Object
ColumnCurrencyFormatSetter: Helper class for setting columns' format to currency. This should be used only after calling .setCellValueFactory() on columns to be formatted.
